$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the run normalized the quoting of the hand-written test job (`name: 'Unit tests'` became `name: "Unit tests"`). The parse is the same and the job runs the same, so only a scorer that compares the job's bytes sees that the edit touched a job it did not write.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean. The test job's source differs from the pipeline's by its quotes, so the preserved job element misses and every other element is present.

elementMisses: preserved-job-test: job test was changed: its bytes are not the ones the pipeline held
